measures.name: Ordered Quantity
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( Sales[QuantityOrderedPrimaryUOM] ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( Sales[Record Type] ), TRIM ( Sales[Record Type] ) = "Sales Detail" ) ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( Sales[Status Code Next] ), TRIM ( Sales[Status Code Next] ) = "999" ) ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( Sales[BusinessUnit] ), TRIM ( Sales[BusinessUnit] ) IN { "CINC", "CIN2", "AUBA", "AUB2", "SING", "SNG4" } ) ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( Sales[Promised Shipment Date] >= TODAY () - 183 ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( Sales[Order Type] ), NOT TRIM ( Sales[Order Type] ) IN { "S5", "ST" } ) ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( Sales[Line Type] ), NOT CONTAINSSTRING ( Sales[Line Type], "F" ) ) ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( Sales[Status Code Last] ), NOT TRIM ( Sales[Status Code Last] ) IN { "980", "984" } ) ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( Sales[QuantityOrderedPrimaryUOM] > 0 ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( 'Customer Ship To'[Sales Business Unit] ), TRIM ( COALESCE ( 'Customer Ship To'[Sales Business Unit], "" ) ) <> "INT" ) ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( 'Item Branch'[Master Planning Family] ), CONTAINSSTRING ( 'Item Branch'[Master Planning Family], "F" ) ) )
)

measures.name: R19 SS Include
measures.expression:
IF (
    TRIM ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Item Branch'[Business Unit] ) ) IN { "CINC", "CIN2", "AUBA", "AUB2", "SING", "SNG4" }
        && SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Item Branch'[SafetyStock] ) > 1
        && TRIM ( COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Item Branch'[Stocking Type] ), "" ) ) <> "O"
        && CONTAINSSTRING ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Item Branch'[Master Planning Family] ), "F" ),
    1,
    0
)

measures.name: Last Refreshed Label
measures.expression: "Last refreshed: " & FORMAT ( [Last Updated], "MMM d, yyyy h:mm:ss AM/PM" ) & " ET"
